using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.CSharp;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.ServiceProxying.CSharp
{
    public class CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GenerateProxyAsync_LogsInformationOnFileCreation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>>();
            var cliHttpClientFactory = new Mock<Volo.Abp.Cli.Http.CliHttpClientFactory>();
            var jsonSerializer = new Mock<Volo.Abp.Json.IJsonSerializer>();

            var generator = new CSharpServiceProxyGenerator(cliHttpClientFactory.Object, jsonSerializer.Object);

            // Inject the logger via reflection since the Logger property is protected in base class
            var loggerField = typeof(ServiceProxyGeneratorBase<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>)
                .GetProperty("Logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            if (loggerField != null)
            {
                loggerField.SetValue(generator, mockLogger.Object);
            }

            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);

            var args = new GenerateProxyArgs
            {
                WorkDirectory = tempDir,
                Folder = "ClientProxies",
                CommandName = "GenerateProxy",
                WithoutContracts = false
            };

            // Act
            await generator.GenerateProxyAsync(args);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().StartsWith("Create ")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);

            // Cleanup
            Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ServiceProxying.CSharp;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.ServiceProxying.CSharp
{
    public class CSharpServiceProxyGeneratorTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task GenerateProxyAsync_LogsInformationOnFileCreation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator>>();
            var cliHttpClientFactory = new Mock<Volo.Abp.Cli.Http.CliHttpClientFactory>();
            var jsonSerializer = new Mock<Volo.Abp.Json.IJsonSerializer>();

            var generator = new CSharpServiceProxyGenerator(cliHttpClientFactory.Object, jsonSerializer.Object);

            // Inject the logger via property since it is public settable
            generator.Logger = mockLogger.Object;

            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);

            var args = new GenerateProxyArgs(
                commandName: "GenerateProxy",
                workDirectory: tempDir,
                module: null,
                url: "http://localhost",
                output: null,
                target: null,
                apiName: null,
                source: null,
                folder: "ClientProxies",
                serviceType: null,
                entryPoint: null,
                withoutContracts: false);

            // Setup mocks to avoid real HTTP calls and JSON deserialization
            // We need to mock GetApplicationApiDescriptionModelAsync to return a minimal valid model
            // But it's protected virtual, so we can subclass to override it

            var testGenerator = new TestCSharpServiceProxyGenerator(cliHttpClientFactory.Object, jsonSerializer.Object, mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            await testGenerator.GenerateProxyAsync(args);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().StartsWith("Create ")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);

            // Cleanup
            Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
        }

        private class TestCSharpServiceProxyGenerator : CSharpServiceProxyGenerator
        {
            private readonly ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator> _logger;

            public TestCSharpServiceProxyGenerator(
                Volo.Abp.Cli.Http.CliHttpClientFactory cliHttpClientFactory,
                Volo.Abp.Json.IJsonSerializer jsonSerializer,
                ILogger<CSharpServiceProxyGenerator> logger) : base(cliHttpClientFactory, jsonSerializer)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                Logger = logger;
            }

            protected override Task<ApplicationApiDescriptionModel> GetApplicationApiDescriptionModelAsync(GenerateProxyArgs args, ApplicationApiDescriptionModelRequestDto requestDto = null)
            {
                // Return a minimal ApplicationApiDescriptionModel with one controller and interface to trigger the code path
                var model = ApplicationApiDescriptionModel.Create();

                var controller = new ControllerApiDescriptionModel
                {
                    Interfaces = new System.Collections.Generic.List<InterfaceApiDescriptionModel>
                    {
                        new InterfaceApiDescriptionModel
                        {
                            Type = "MyAppService",
                            Methods = new System.Collections.Generic.List<MethodApiDescriptionModel>()
                        }
                    }
                };

                var module = new ModuleApiDescriptionModel();
                module.Controllers.Add("MyController", controller);
                model.Modules.Add("Default", module);

                return Task.FromResult(model);
            }
        }
    }
}
